assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game environment concept sheet for a 2.5D narrative stealth-adventure
Primary request: Create one polished 16:9 landscape concept sheet showing five distinct but geographically connected districts of Greyfen, a rainbound frontier fortress in a drowned fen. This is an original visual direction called Ashen Diorama.
Scene/backdrop: five cinematic environment vignettes arranged as a harmonious concept sheet with subtle frameless transitions, each viewed from the same fixed three-quarter orthographic camera at roughly 35 degrees: (1) Anchor Hollow and West Causeway, with a split ash tree, old stone anchor, drowned reed beds, black rainwater and a narrow mud road; (2) West Gate, Grey Keep and Oathstone, with hand-hewn basalt battlements, broken gate towers, steep wet roofs and a weathered ritual stone; (3) Granary and Refuge Row, with a broad timber granary, patched canvas homes, stacked supplies and protective amber ward lanterns; (4) Field Clinic and Southern Drains, with low stone clinic buildings, rain gutters, flooded steps and a half-visible drainage tunnel; (5) Water Gate and Fen Edge, with an oxidized iron sluice wheel, dark channels, flood barriers, reed islands and distant storm haze.
Subject: the environments are the heroes; include only a few tiny anonymous human and horned-refugee silhouettes for scale, with no identifiable protagonists and no combat pose.
Style/medium: original high-fidelity painterly 3D diorama concept art; sculpted miniature-scale architecture, tactile hand-painted surfaces, restrained pixel-like dithering only on selected edge accents, rich depth layering, elegant readable silhouettes, professional game art production sheet, neither photorealistic nor cartoonish.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape; exactly five readable environment views with consistent camera, scale, palette and material language; strong foreground-midground-background separation; each district has a clear focal landmark and navigable paths; visually cohesive rather than a busy collage.
Lighting/mood: bronze storm dusk under heavy charcoal clouds; cold rain-blue and fen-teal ambient light opposed by localized burnt-amber ward lights; subtle volumetric fog, wet reflections, long soft shadows, restrained bloom, shallow-focus diorama staging; tense, humane, mournful and beautiful.
Color palette: charcoal basalt, rain blue, fen teal, desaturated canvas and timber, oxidized bronze, burnt amber light, very limited muted blood-red accents.
Materials/textures: rain-polished basalt, soaked timber grain, patched waxed canvas, churned mud, black water, moss, reeds, rusted iron, hammered bronze, puddle ripples and roof runoff.
Constraints: entirely original world and visual design; no text, letters, captions, labels, numbers, logos, interface elements, borders, trademarks or watermark; no recognizable characters or assets from any existing game; no modern technology; no giant monsters; no decorative fantasy magic overload; no sunny weather; no generic heroic pose.
Avoid: branded game styles or compositions, anime styling, flat vector art, simplistic primitives, photorealistic film stills, excessive bloom, excessive depth-of-field blur, clutter that obscures paths, illegible dark crush.

confirmed: exactly five coherent environment views
distinct district landmarks and navigable path intent
consistent three-quarter storm-dusk presentation
wet basalt, timber, canvas, mud, water and reed material language
cold rain light opposed by localized amber refuge light
no visible text, labels, logos, watermark or UI
no recognizable third-party character or game asset
production_notes: reduce the Keep's gothic monumentality to frontier-fort scale
raise selected route and doorway midtones at gameplay exposure
retain localized amber without excessive bloom
use as mood, composition and material reference only; do not trace or project into production assets

assets.prompt:
